title: General density theorem and Lebesgue differentiation (Simon 3.16, 3.17, with 3.11(1), 3.13, 3.15)
statement: For metric spaces X (in a common universe) and outer measures μ on X that are Borel regular, open σ-finite and have the Symmetric Vitali Property: (3.16) for every μ-measurable A, μ(A ∩ B_ρ(x))/μ(B_ρ(x)) → 1 as ρ ↓ 0 for μ-a.e. x ∈ A and → 0 for μ-a.e. x ∈ X ∖ A; (3.17) for every μ-measurable f : X → ℝ such that each x has some ρ > 0 with ∫_{B_ρ(x)} |f| dμ < ∞, μ(B_ρ(x))^{−1}∫_{B_ρ(x)} f dμ → f(x) as ρ ↓ 0 for μ-a.e. x.
